question: Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races missed by Formula 1 drivers across all years. Include only drivers who missed fewer than three races in a given year and who switched teams between their appearances immediately before and after their hiatus (i.e., the constructor ID for the race right before their first missed race must be different from the constructor ID for the race right after their last missed race in that year). Do not group results by year; return just the overall averages across the entire dataset.
sql:
-- Final result
WITH hiatuses AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, first_round, last_round,
        (last_round - first_round + 1) AS races_missed,
        first_round - 1 AS round_before,
        last_round + 1 AS round_after
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id = -1
),
hiatus_info AS (
    SELECT * FROM hiatuses WHERE races_missed < 3
),
constructor_check AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        h.year, h.driver_id, h.first_round, h.last_round, h.races_missed,
        rb_res.constructor_id AS constructor_before,
        ra_res.constructor_id AS constructor_after
    FROM hiatus_info h
    JOIN races rb ON rb.year = h.year AND rb.round = h.round_before
    JOIN results rb_res ON rb_res.race_id = rb.race_id AND rb_res.driver_id = h.driver_id
    JOIN races ra ON ra.year = h.year AND ra.round = h.round_after
    JOIN results ra_res ON ra_res.race_id = ra.race_id AND ra_res.driver_id = h.driver_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * first_round) AS overall_avg_first_round,
    AVG(1.0 * last_round) AS overall_avg_last_round
FROM constructor_check
WHERE constructor_before != constructor_after
